Regulatory compliance for phone numbers (requirements, applications, linking)

Usage:
  plivo numbers compliance [flags]
  plivo numbers compliance [command]

Available Commands:
  create       Create + submit a compliance application (multipart; auto-submits)
  delete       Delete a compliance application (requires --yes)
  get          Get a compliance application by ID
  link         Bulk-link numbers to accepted compliance applications
  list         List compliance applications
  requirements List documents/fields required to activate a regulated number
  update       Update a rejected compliance application (multipart; auto-resubmits)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for compliance

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            preview requests and local changes without sending or writing anything
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --show-secrets       show auth tokens and passwords in API responses instead of [REDACTED]
      --timeout duration   request timeout: seconds, or a duration such as 90s or 2m (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo numbers compliance [command] --help" for more information about a command.
